title: Change the name on a company or partnership contractor licence
summary: Update your company or partnership contractor licence details if the business name or a director/member's name has changed.
intro:
If you hold a company or partnership contractor licence and the business name has changed, or a company director or partnership member has changed their name, you must update the licence details at a Service NSW Centre within 7 days.

Note: You must apply for a new licence if you're:
who_can_apply: Hold a company or partnership contractor licence
A company director or partnership member has changed their name
what_you_need: A current ASIC extract showing your new company or partnership name (original copy to be viewed and verified at Service NSW)
The PDF form – 'Change of name and use of other names or aliases'
Marriage certificate, or change of name certificate
Certified evidence of the name change (if a director or member's name changed)

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and provide the information in person.

faqs.q: How quickly must I update my licence details?
faqs.a: You must update the licence details at a Service NSW Centre within 7 days.

faqs.q: What do I need if the business name has changed?
faqs.a: You need your licence number and a current ASIC extract showing the new company or partnership name.

faqs.q: What documentation is needed if a director or member changes their name?
faqs.a: You need certified evidence of the name change, such as a marriage certificate or change of name certificate.
